text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! You look way too depressed, man.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, nothing to do but keep our chins up and practice.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because raw talent can't settle this that it gets so exciting.
Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
